finding: Unit picker sends unsupported effective-date filter
reproduction: Open a product opening allocation and load units; request item unit-bindings with limit=50 and as_of=2090-01-01
expected: Load bindings successfully; filter dated revisions for books begin
actual: Opening bindings use only limit/cursor; published revisions retain as_of. Picker/policy regressions pass.
recommendation: Remove as_of from binding list; retain date filter on revisions

finding: SKU binding and unit quantity rules are not enforced by master validation
reproduction: Validate a same-company active whole-piece SKU with quantity 1.5; repeat using an unrelated MASS unit
expected: Reject fractional whole counts and units without an eligible dated SKU binding
actual: Native draft and execution admission use signed dated SKU-unit projections; refuse invalid grids, roles, dimensions and absent or foreign evidence.
recommendation: Add versioned SKU unit facts and validate date role dimension precision and increment at admission

finding: Barcode and effective-unit ratios use inexact JSON numbers
reproduction: Serialize numerator 9007199254740993 and denominator 9007199254740995; parse response in JavaScript
expected: Exact integer strings survive the complete API SDK and browser round trip
actual: Public barcode/effective-unit ratios serialize as exact decimal strings; OpenAPI and SDK regenerated.
recommendation: Serialize ratio strings and synchronize OpenAPI SDK consumers and tests

finding: Pack scan selects a disabled non-base stock unit
reproduction: Scan a BOX binding at 12 PCS per box in a Receipt Note; load the PCS inventory profile; save
expected: Authoritative pack conversion or an actionable refusal before applying an unusable selection
actual: Physical pack scans refuse with a base-barcode instruction before changing the line. Deliberate alternate entry uses the native quantity workflow.
recommendation: Preserve base identity and binding evidence; implement native conversion or clear supported refusal

finding: New product base rules ignore configured quantity defaults
reproduction: Use a COUNT master with increment 1 and company numeric default increment 5; build new product setup
expected: Offer or apply native narrowed company default with explicit override or acceptance
actual: Created base binding uses increment 1 without offering the company suggestion
recommendation: Use authoritative authoring suggestions before deriving base and alternate serial-safe steps

finding: Create wizard ignores required and default-enabled conversion choice
reproduction: Set alternate_units REQUIRED or OPTIONAL default true; start create wizard with no alternate choice
expected: Required conversion is visibly required and validated; optional default initializes choice
actual: Checkbox starts false; base-only setup has no creation error for required alternate
recommendation: Initialize choices from resolved settings and validate required completion before leaving step

finding: Nonzero physical quantity rounds to visible zero
reproduction: Display stock 0.0010 with company quantity precision 2
expected: Keep configured display and also expose exact nonzero stock quantity
actual: On hand cell reads 0.00 with no exact secondary value
recommendation: Reuse exact secondary quantity display across stock and opening views

finding: Stock quantities lack actual base-unit labels
reproduction: List products using PCS and KG in stock balances or opening history
expected: Authorized unit identity and human label accompany each quantity
actual: Bare quantities and product links give no unit column; list schemas lack base-unit field
recommendation: Add protected native base-unit context without per-row cross-service queries

finding: General stock capture cannot retain alternate entered-unit evidence
reproduction: Enter stock in BOX outside opening and inspect StockLine and stock UI
expected: Retain entered unit revision ratio and authoritative base quantity for every stock action
actual: Ordinary stock retains entered revision/quantity and authoritative base quantity; Catalog fence and Accounting execution enforce exact conversion. Existing release gates still apply.
recommendation: Extend one native entered/base contract across receipts dispatch transfers and returns

finding: Measured dual quantities stop at Catalog authoring and preview
reproduction: Use a measured SKU and try opening or ordinary stock in packs plus actual kg
expected: Capture both actual measures and admit their native grids without applying nominal weight
actual: Measured opening and ordinary stock retain explicit entered and actual base measures; both grids enforced; nominal ratios never drive execution.
recommendation: Plan measured capture provenance and value rules with native stock owners

finding: Compound mechanisms lack complete authoring and transaction flows
reproduction: Try structured 2 boxes plus 3 pieces in stock UI; inspect multiplicative compound authoring and resolution callers
expected: Structured components convert natively; separate multiplicative definitions have approved authoring and resolution
actual: Catalog additive preview is API-only; multiplicative table and helper have no reachable production authoring or resolver
recommendation: Plan additive entry independently from multiplicative decomposition and recursive resolution

finding: Jurisdiction unit and GST UQC mapping management is API-only
reproduction: Attempt to manage dated official unit codes using tenant-admin menus
expected: Supported UI uses existing create list detail close and date-overlap contracts
actual: Native API exists; no corresponding management screen
recommendation: Expose existing protected APIs with dated mapping and closure controls

finding: Unit-aware count and calculated adjustment runtime is missing
reproduction: Perform physical count at recorded cutoff while movements continue; approve surplus without known cost
expected: Distinguish uncounted from counted zero; calculate exact base variance; reconcile later movements; require cost review
actual: Non-serial USABLE company-owned physical counts have immutable cutoff generations, versioned observations, later-movement reconciliation, exact-once variance, native cost/review and reversal. Serial counts and damage/disposal remain pending.
recommendation: Implement documented cutoff and verified-cost policies through native count admission and reconciliation

finding: Effective-product readiness cannot reflect verified owner activation
reproduction: Inspect effective stock goods with complete inventory setup and compare owner capabilities
expected: Verified owner readiness can be represented without bypassing release gates
actual: Catalog response schema has only NOT_APPLICABLE and UNAVAILABLE; stock branch always reports unavailable
recommendation: Integrate authenticated native owner readiness; retain fail-closed missing or stale source behavior

finding: Two unit isolation and constraint tests fail during fixture setup
reproduction: Run selected Catalog tests/test_units.py database and isolation cases
expected: Reach cross-tenant and FK assertions with correctly scoped fixture writes
actual: Both fail before assertions with TenantContextError from stock-source before_flush
recommendation: Scope each tenant fixture write correctly; preserve production tenant and source-fence guards
